title: G5: Don't automatically un-pair on phones that can't automatically re-pair
symptom: Some phones require user intervention to pair with a Bluetooth device. The old and new G5 collectors can automatically un-pair from the G5 to try to resolve a connection problem, but on phones that can't re-pair automatically, this makes things worse, and xDrip won't get any data until the user manually intervenes.
cause: The collectors automatically un-pair from the G5 to resolve connection problems, but on phones that cannot automatically re-pair, this leaves the user without data until manual intervention.
fix: xDrip should not automatically un-pair at all on phones that cannot automatically re-pair. The issue was resolved in a nightly build, and the user confirmed it works as expected with fewer instances of manual repair.
evidence_quote: Yup, it's working as expected -- far fewer instances where I have to manually repair because OB1 unpaired automatically.
